audience: Portuguese businesses and accountants who manage customers, sales and purchases in TOConline

useCases.title: Find customer and supplier details
useCases.text: List customers or suppliers, then read a selected record and its company relationships.

useCases.title: Review sales documents and invoice lines
useCases.text: List sales documents, inspect a selected document and read its line items without issuing, changing or finalizing it.

useCases.title: Check purchases and recorded payments
useCases.text: Read purchase documents and recorded purchase payments, then inspect one payment and its related records.

useCases.title: Look up products and accounting reference data
useCases.text: Find products or services by item code and read the company’s tax descriptors and units of measure.
